answer: Sybil resistance binds each agent’s signing key to an enclave and accepts it only with remote attestation of the approved MRENCLAVE. A copied VM can duplicate software, but cannot export the enclave-protected key or forge a vendor-signed quote; under this model, creating another valid identity requires another genuine enclave-capable processor, not just virtual duplication. This hardware gate is no velvet guarantee against compromised silicon or vendors, but it raises the cost of a Sybil gale.
